title: Tiny, cute watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body of watering can -->
    <rect x="30" y="45" width="42" height="34" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
    <!-- lighter body highlight -->
    <rect x="34" y="49" width="34" height="14" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#81D4FA"/>
    <!-- bottom rim -->
    <rect x="30" y="73" width="42" height="6" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#29B6F6"/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M72 48 Q86 48 86 62 Q86 74 72 74" fill="none" stroke="#FFB74D" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- handle highlight -->
    <path d="M74 52 Q82 52 82 62 Q82 70 74 70" fill="none" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- spout -->
    <path d="M30 56 L12 42 L12 52 L26 62 Z" fill="#FF8A65"/>
    <!-- spout top highlight -->
    <path d="M28 57 L14 45 L14 49 L26 60 Z" fill="#FFAB91"/>
    <!-- spout end cap -->
    <ellipse cx="13" cy="47" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#FF7043"/>
    <!-- rose (sprinkler head) -->
    <ellipse cx="10" cy="47" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#FB8C00"/>
    <ellipse cx="10" cy="47" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#FFECB3"/>
    <!-- sprinkle holes -->
    <circle cx="8" cy="44" r="1" fill="#FB8C00"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="44" r="1" fill="#FB8C00"/>
    <circle cx="8" cy="48" r="1" fill="#FB8C00"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="48" r="1" fill="#FB8C00"/>
    <circle cx="10" cy="51" r="1" fill="#FB8C00"/>
    <!-- cute face on body -->
    <circle cx="43" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="#1A237E"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="58" r="3.5" fill="#1A237E"/>
    <circle cx="44" cy="57" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="57" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d="M46 65 Q50 69 54 65" fill="none" stroke="#1A237E" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <circle cx="37" cy="65" r="3" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.7"/>
    <circle cx="63" cy="65" r="3" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- water drops from spout -->
    <circle cx="6" cy="55" r="2" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
    <circle cx="9" cy="60" r="1.5" fill="#81D4FA"/>
    <circle cx="5" cy="63" r="1.5" fill="#4FC3F7"/>
  </g>
</svg>
